evidence_scope: Observed real browser AudioWorklet, WebSocket, service STT/search/TTS events and rendered chat. Curated observations, not a raw audio/event archive or a benchmark.

input_source.delivery: An isolated browser's test-only getUserMedia supplied a MediaStreamDestination. The production PCM worklet and WebSocket then sent the actual samples.

checks.failure_boundary: Existing outgoing WebSocket buffer guard exceeded 96000 bytes. The UI stopped the session and marked the unfinished response instead of claiming completion.

diagnosis.initial_failure_root_cause: Not conclusively determined. The append spans do not establish Azure send latency as the cause; later browser scheduling gaps were observed.
